name: actiTIME
description_en:
actiTIME tracks work against projects and tasks, then connects logged hours with estimates, costs and billing reports. It is relevant to a project manager or services business needing to explain where labor went, rather than only record attendance.

Online and Self-Hosted are separate deployment choices. The Free Online edition is limited to three users and reduced functionality; a free trial of full functionality should not be mistaken for the permanent Free entitlement.
description_zh:
actiTIME 按项目和任务记录工作，并把工时关联到估算、成本及计费报告，适合需要解释人工投入的项目经理或服务业务，不只是记录考勤。

Online 与 Self-Hosted 是不同部署选择。Free Online 限三位用户且功能缩减，完整功能免费试用不能当作永久免费权益。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate recorded hours with a defined project and task.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将记录工时关联到项目及任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Compare time/cost actuals with estimates and billable rates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按估算与可计费费率比较工时/成本实际值。

en: Create a client project and tasks, assign people and define estimates and rates. A consultant records hours to the correct task; the manager compares actual time with planned work and reviews the billable output. A saved timesheet is not proof that its client, rate or billable classification is correct. Evaluate a non-billable entry and a corrected entry before using totals for an invoice. No invoice or timesheet was executed here.
zh: 创建客户项目及任务、分配人员、定义估算和费率。顾问把工时记到正确任务，经理比较实际与计划，并检查计费输出。工时表保存成功，不证明客户、费率或可计费分类正确。用于发票前，应评估不可计费记录及更正记录。本次未实际执行工时表或发票。

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Active users and hosting change the cost
sections.title_zh: 活跃用户及托管影响成本
sections.en:
The annual Online view lists $6 per user monthly equivalent for one to forty users and $5 for forty-one to two hundred; larger teams use a fixed-cost offer. Active users include managers and administrators, not just people logging hours. Tax and checkout currency need confirmation. Free requires selecting that edition after trial.

Self-Hosted uses a one-time licence and internal server; the customer owns maintenance. The pricing FAQ says minor upgrades are free but major upgrades cost the initial price. Online includes vendor maintenance/backups, which are not equivalent to a customer-run server’s recovery plan. Neither model implies open-source redistribution rights.
sections.zh:
Online 年付视图列一至四十位用户月均 $6、四十一至二百位 $5，更大团队为固定费用方案。活跃用户包含经理和管理员，不只是记工时的人。税费及结算货币需确认；Free 需试用后选择该版本。

Self-Hosted 为一次性许可、内部服务器，由客户维护。定价 FAQ 表示小版本升级免费，大版本升级按初始价格收费。Online 含厂商维护/备份，不等同客户服务器的恢复计划，两种模式都不意味着开源再分发权。

sections.title_en: Keep the time record and financial interpretation separate
sections.title_zh: 区分工时记录与财务解释
sections.en:
Prepare task identifiers, rates, user access and reporting periods before migration. Investigate missing or changed hours in the source timesheet before regenerating billing exports. An API/export option does not establish compatibility with every accounting system.

Project-oriented teams should evaluate the workflow; a buyer needing only location-based attendance may have a different requirement. No deployment, API, permission, backup restore or financial calculation was tested, and exact licence/retention terms remain unverified.
sections.zh:
迁移前准备任务标识、费率、用户访问及报告周期。重新生成计费导出前，应先在来源工时表调查缺失或修改记录。提供 API/导出不证明兼容所有财务系统。

项目型团队可评估该流程，只需定位考勤的买家可能有不同要求。未测试部署、API、权限、备份恢复或财务计算，具体许可/保留条款仍未核实。

research_gaps.zh: 具体软件许可、结算税费/货币、审批行为、财务集成及恢复未测试。
